notes: Asking prices of homes listed for sale (under-offer / sold STC excluded) within 2.5 km of the site, from OnTheMarket postcode-sector searches (coverage of the circle 100%). Floor area as stated by the agent (listing's structured size or text), read from 123 listing pages (nearest houses/flats first); null when not stated. area_source: 'structured' (listing's size field), 'text' (total stated in the text) or 'conflict' (both given, more than 10% apart; m2 = structured, m2_text = stated). tenure / lease_years from the listing's key facts. sale_flags: cash_only, refurb_project, probate, short_lease (< 80 years left) - not ordinary market sales. type 'other' = land, retirement/age-restricted homes, unspecified. Shared-ownership and auction lots are marked in price_qualifier (a share price / auction guide, not comparable with whole-home asking prices). new_home: New Homes channel / new-home flag / explicit wording ('brand new', plot no.), not a warranty mention alone.
